value: Never wait on a process with pgrep -f "<string>" when the waiting shell's own command line contains <string> — pgrep -f matches full command lines, so the wait loop matches itself and never exits. Cost us 87min: a subagent ran 'until ! pgrep -f "codex exec review"; do sleep 5; done' after launching codex, and four such loops deadlocked. Wait on the PID (wait $!) or match a pattern the loop cannot contain.
